answer: A claim advances only through a spiral of attestations from three clusters whose reviewers are distinct non-kin established identities with separate funding histories. Each round locks one fresh nectar bond, repaid live each round, so a farm cannot buy one bond and reuse it. A canyon cap limits any single cluster's weight to one-third, and a reviewer caught contradicting its own earlier claim forfeits its bond at once. Ten fakes therefore owe thirty live bonds plus thirty separate cluster confirmations, and no bond, confirmation, or canyon cut can be pooled or reused across clones.
